segments.name: Medical device
segments.description: Sells neurosurgery navigation, therapy, neurocritical care and biologics and drug delivery products, plus ClearPoint and IRRA flow capital equipment and software to hospitals and clinicians.
segments.evidence: The Company is a medical device company offering precise navigation to the brain, and provides clinical products and preclinical development services for controlled drug and device delivery.

revenueModel.text: Hospitals, surgeons and trial sponsors pay for disposable products, capital equipment and software, plus development services and consultation for preclinical and clinical trials.
